kill_switch.definition: Mechanism to immediately halt one or more engine processes

lockdown.definition: Restricted operational state with reduced engine availability based on severity level

lockdown_normal.definition: All systems operational, standard logging, no restrictions

lockdown_elevated.definition: Enhanced logging and monitoring, increased heartbeat frequency

lockdown_high.definition: Non-essential engines paused, data protection pre-staged

lockdown_critical.definition: Essential engines only, data encrypted at rest, emergency communication active

lockdown_full.definition: GOV+BLD tiers only, full network isolation, all data encrypted

severity_1.definition: Catastrophic incident: system-wide compromise, confirmed data breach, SOVEREIGN credential compromise

severity_2.definition: Major incident: multiple tiers affected, active external attack, significant data at risk

severity_3.definition: Moderate incident: single tier or critical engine affected, suspicious activity confirmed

severity_4.definition: Minor incident: single non-critical engine anomaly, resource exhaustion

severity_5.definition: Informational: anomaly detected but not confirmed, monitoring only

authority_elevation.definition: Temporary grant of higher authority level for emergency response

data_protection.definition: Emergency mode that snapshots, encrypts, and archives critical data to R2 cold storage

snapshot.definition: Complete capture of all engine statuses, sessions, tasks, and system resources at a point in time

recovery.definition: Staged process to return system to full operational status after emergency

incident.definition: Any event that threatens system integrity, availability, or confidentiality

blast.definition: Simultaneous notification through all available communication channels

rto.definition: Maximum acceptable time from incident declaration to verified operational status

rpo.definition: Maximum acceptable amount of data loss measured in time

failsafe.definition: System defaults to safe/restricted state when component fails

escalation.definition: Increase in lockdown level or incident severity based on new information

de_escalation.definition: Decrease in lockdown level after threat is contained or eliminated

containment.definition: Actions to prevent incident from spreading to unaffected systems

playbook.definition: Pre-defined sequence of automated and manual actions for a specific incident type

sovereign.definition: Authority level 11.0, held exclusively by Commander, cannot be delegated

dead_man_switch.definition: Safety mechanism that triggers if BLD04 itself becomes unresponsive

tier.definition: Engine classification: GOV (governance), BLD (bloodline), OPS (operations), INT (intelligence), AUX (auxiliary)

full_system_kill.meaning: Activation of kill switch at LOCKDOWN level, stopping all engines

data_protection_lockdown.meaning: Automatic data protection triggered by CRITICAL or LOCKDOWN escalation

authority_elevation_emergency.meaning: Temporary privilege grant tied to an active incident

staged_recovery.meaning: Recovery process with step-by-step lockdown de-escalation
